description: Defines an abstract class SuiteEditorSettings for managing editor configuration settings in SuiteCRM, including properties for content, element IDs, size, group, and click handler, with methods for construction and extension of settings.

classes.name: SuiteEditorSettings
classes.description: An abstract class for storing and extending editor settings, including properties for content, element IDs, size, group, and click handler, with methods for initialization and extension.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally extends settings if provided.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the current settings with provided array or object.
